ChatGPT disputes that a mole is dimensionless. 
SI has its own base dimension definition for the "dimensionless dimension": N. The corresponding base unit in SI is *mole*, which is a count widely used in chemistry. A mole is 602,214,076,000,000,000,000,000 individuals. When the "individuals" are atoms or molecules, a mole of individuals can be weighed on a kitchen scale; a mole of water molecules weighs 8 grams. In contrast, a mole of people would weigh about 10 times the mass of the Earth; not a convenient unit. 
:::
